Harvest rate proxy of the chr rule

Source: R/fishing_pressure.R
harvest_rate_proxy.Rd

The harvest rate proxy of the constant harvest rate (chr) rule (ICES 2025, method 2.2): the mean of catch / index over the reference years in which the mean length of the catch above L_c is above L_F=M (f = L_mean / L_F=M > 1).

Usage

harvest_rate_proxy(ldist, index, landings, Lc, Linf, hr_years)

Arguments

ldist

A data frame with the columns year, length and n (e.g. from catch_ldist() or rule_ldist()).

index

A data frame with the columns year and index (see index_series()).

landings

A data frame with the columns year and landings, in the units of the index.

Lc

Length at first capture.

Linf

L_inf (e.g. from linf_from_catch()).

hr_years

Candidate reference years.

Value

A tibble by year with the columns year, L (mean length above L_c), f, index, landings, hr (landings / index) and used (a reference year with f > 1). The proxy is the attribute hr_proxy; the attributes lc, linf and lfm hold L_c, L_inf and L_F=M.
